text:
Opus 5.5 Fast has a clear price edge over GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast: $8/$40 vs $12/$60 per million input/output tokens, for global API processing with Sol prompts up to 272K input tokens.

Vercel’s latest P50 snapshot puts Opus Fast at 273 tokens/s. A comparable Sol Ultrafast measurement is still missing, so calling this a speed tie is premature.

Sol Ultrafast also goes beyond the API: it’s available in Codex and ChatGPT Work on Pro $500 and eligible Enterprise/Edu plans.

media.alt: Comparison of Claude Opus 5.5 Fast and GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast. Opus has a Vercel P50 snapshot of 273 tokens per second; a comparable Sol measurement is unavailable. Global API input/output rates per million tokens are $8/$40 versus $12/$60, with Sol prompts up to 272K input tokens. Both have coding-agent access; Sol Ultrafast in Codex and ChatGPT Work requires Pro $500 or eligible Enterprise/Edu plans.
